'''Fett Set Your Course for Alderaan, then Hoth, then Yavin REVISED''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Fett]]
* '''Published:''' 1 March 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS2]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Set Your Course For Alderaan / The Ultimate Power In The Universe|TA-D-setyourcourseforalderaan.gif|label=Set Your Course For Alderaan}}
* '''Strategy:''' Set Your Course For Alderaan
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS2 SYCFA Fett DS 2003 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

Essentially, this is the standard SYCFA deck, geared towards capitalizing on the -2 deploy and +2 force drain with the Imperial Star Destroyers.

The published list has 64 cards.

== Strategy ==

Start off with SYCFA.

On my first turn, use SYCFA to pull a DS Gunner.

2nd turn, send Gunner to used pile to pull Superlaser

I then move to Alderaan, and sit around pulling Death Star sites and gunners, I just make sure I blow Alderaan before anything jeapordizes the Death Star.

Use A Million Voices Crying Out to pull CPI, if I haven't already drawn it.

Blow up Alderaan, use TUPITU to deploy hoth, and move there.

Blow Hoth, deploy Yavin, and hopefully I already have Yavin DB.

Blow Yavin.

I can then deploy a Battleground System every turn, and my Imperial & Super Star Destroyers force drain for +2.

Admiral Chiraneau adds 1 to every force drain controlled by a Star Destroyer within 2 parsecs.  Because of this, most of my planets are around parsec 6-7.

Using Firepower, I can deploy weapons from my Lost Pile, and any starship with 2 or more weapons is power +2.

I use Imperial Command to pull Admiral Chiraneau, or Motti (v)

Motti (v) adds three to power of every unique star destroyer, 5 if armed with a starship weapon, which I have a few of.

Imperial Helmsmen draw one battle destiny if not able to do otherwise on an SD

Most of my Star Destroyers have Ability 2 pilots, the others have Weapon Bonuses (EG, Judicator +2 destiny, Thunderflare fires Turbolasers for free

The executor sites are mainly because they provide my opponent with no generation.

This is really the same deck that I posted a day ago, but the posting is cleaned up.  I won't mind getting another 2, but only if there is really a problem with my deck.
